assumptions_and_unapproved_design.single_stdio_channel: GuestPublisherPairingGuestChannelV1 fixes transport=lima-stdio-v1. GuestPublisherPairingStdioFrameV1 fixes Begin -> Hello -> Transcript -> Anchor newline frames. run_guest_pairing_stdio_v1 reads/writes that one retained stream. This is unapproved and is not authority.
assumptions_and_unapproved_design.one_child_channel: The channel object binds one PM-root/instance/guest-machine/source/artifact/transfer-nonce tuple. No implementation of an additional logical child session exists.
assumptions_and_unapproved_design.alternate_channel_or_transport: No second channel was added. The control gate's language treating ssh as an alternate child transport must not be read as a prohibition on a logically distinct session over the same PM-bound SSH transport; amendment 0008 says it is not such authority either.
assumptions_and_unapproved_design.tty: Contract-required fingerprint/challenge/literal confirmation remains intended for guest /dev/tty. Current limactl shell exposes one shell stream with a tty toggle, not an independently retained data FD; the current code cannot prove simultaneous independent TTY and ticket/transcript channel.
assumptions_and_unapproved_design.operator_confirmation: No intentional confirmation transfer through argv, env, or protocol pipe is added. The unresolved architecture is precisely the missing independent TTY/data session.
assumptions_and_unapproved_design.endpoint: Mac XPC service and fixed Keychain service/account conventions are added under 0007; no alternate broker endpoint/socket is added.
assumptions_and_unapproved_design.selectors: Fixed prefix/control path, fixed helper names, fixed FD3 bootstrap, and fixed lima-stdio-v1 are assumed. Ticket binds PM, machine, stage/artifact/component/challenge/generation; no dynamic selector is introduced.
assumptions_and_unapproved_design.principals: Mac XPC audit token plus designated requirement and protected Keychain P-256 key are the host control principal assumptions; guest operator confirmation remains local TTY. No new Windows/Linux principal is introduced.
assumptions_and_unapproved_design.mapped_lifecycle: scripts/mac/lima-lifecycle.sh still assumes direct lima-action submission for generic mapped lifecycle, while the Mac executor rejects it. This is an unresolved P1, not an authorized bypass.
